subject: Novalink: KV/prompt output sweep & attestation request
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex.park@novalink.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: remove prompt/output logs for Novalink-prod tenant

Hi Rafael,

We need Redwood to execute a complete sanitization for our Novalink-prod tenant. Scope: all prompt inputs, model outputs, and ephemeral KV caches generated between 2026-06-01 and 2027-07-31 tied to tenant id 'novalink-prod' and the following prompt namespaces: customer_support, payment_parser, and billing_assist. This is a formal deletion request under our data residency agreement — we require a certificate of deletion and the ops evidence (sweep logs + manifest).

Requirements:
- Complete removal of prompts/outputs and associated KV entries for the scoped namespaces.
- Confirmation on snapshots/backups retention and whether any artifacts remain off-host.
- Deliverables: sanitized manifest (CSV/pdf), ops sweep log, and a signed attestation that we can store for compliance.
- Target timeline: please confirm expected completion window (we'd prefer within 72 hours).

I've attached a CSV with the specific resource IDs and sample prefixes (attachment: novalink-scope-csv.csv).

Thanks,
Alex Park
Head of Platform Security
Novalink

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@novalink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remove prompt/output logs for Novalink-prod tenant

Alex — thanks for the detail and the CSV. We can do this. High level plan and asks below.

Plan (summary):
1) Ops intake: ticket RW-9876 opened (Connor).
2) Scope validation: Ops will reconcile the CSV against tenant mappings and sample keys.
3) Execution window: we expect to run the sanitization within 48 hours after scope sign-off, delivery of evidence within 24 hours after execution.
4) Outputs: sanitization manifest (pdf + csv), raw sweep log (txt), and a signed attestation (DocuSign).

Immediate asks from Novalink:
- Confirm the namespaces listed are exhaustive for the request (customer_support, payment_parser, billing_assist).
- Confirm whether you want us to also remove derivative embeddings and cached reranking indices (these are separate indices and need explicit sign-off).

Connor will coordinate the operation. Laura (security) included to confirm the attestation language and snapshot/backup notes. Marissa will follow up on the compliance receipt you need.

If you confirm the two bullets above, Connor will kick off RW-9876 and share ETA.

Best,
Rafael
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>, Alex Park <alex.park@novalink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remove prompt/output logs for Novalink-prod tenant

Alex / team — I've created Ops ticket RW-9876 and started scope reconciliation. Quick technical notes and the runbook I'll execute once you confirm the derivative indices decision.

Runbook highlights (for transparency):
- Pre-check: snapshot indexes and list all PSKs matching prefixes from novalink-scope-csv.csv.
- Execution step 1: disable write routing to affected namespaces for a 15-minute window to avoid new entries during truncation.
- Execution step 2: KV prefix purge (sharded sweep) using safe-delete semantics: mark-and-sweep + immediate tombstone TTL enforcement.
- Execution step 3: purge prompt/output tables by tenant id and namespace; we also rotate keys for any transient caches to prevent rehydration.
- Post-check: run full validation query to assert zero rows for scoped ids.
- Evidence: I'll produce rw-9876-sweep-log.txt (raw ops logs) and novalink-sanitization-manifest.pdf (summarized CSV) and attach a manifest CSV.

Notes about backups: our standard snapshot retention may include point-in-time backups depending on your plan. Laura: can you confirm the backup removal/retention exception language we should provide to the customer?

If Novalink confirms derivative embeddings & reranking indices should also be removed, I'll include additional index-truncation steps (adds ~2 hours to execution).

Attachment stubs: rw-9876-sweep-log.txt (ops dry-run excerpts), novalink-scope-csv.csv (from customer).

Connor O'Brien
Senior Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.example.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@novalink.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@novalink.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: remove prompt/output logs for Novalink-prod tenant — completion & attestation

Alex / Emily — thanks for confirming scope over the phone this morning (confirmed: namespaces customer_support, payment_parser, billing_assist; please also remove derivative embeddings and reranking indices). Below is the closure and deliverables for the request.

Summary of work completed (RW-9876):
- Execution window: 2027-08-03 10:30–11:20 PDT.
- Actions: write routing suspended; KV prefix sharded sweep executed; prompt/output tables purged by tenant id/namespace; derivative indices truncated; cache key rotation performed.
- Validation: post-sweep validation queries returned zero matches for all scoped IDs and prefixes.

Deliverables attached:
- novalink-sanitization-manifest.pdf (PDF summary with CSV appendix)
- novalink-scope-csv.csv (original scope)
- rw-9876-sweep-log.txt (ops log excerpts)
- attestation-novalink-docusign.pdf (signed attestation; DocuSign record: https://docusign.com/link/ATT-8492)

Backup/snapshot note (from Security):
Laura Bennett says: "For Novalink's current subscription we maintain 30-day incremental snapshots. We have executed a targeted snapshot scrub for the affected ranges; however, full elimination from long-term archives requires Novalink to request we apply retention override for any archival tier. If you need us to purge archival copies, reply and we'll initiate the extended retention override procedure (timeline ~7 days)."

Closure items and next steps:
- Please confirm receipt of the PDF attestation and manifest.
- If you require DocuSign envelope metadata or a notarized bundle, let us know and we can produce a compliance pack (additional SLA applies).

Thanks — glad we could get this done quickly.

Rafael Mendes
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): novalink-sanitization-manifest.pdf, rw-9876-sweep-log.txt, attestation-novalink-docusign.pdf
